fact: One of a compact family of sub-Earths recently found circling the storied Barnard's Star.
bio: Barnard c is part of a tightly packed system of small, low-mass worlds confirmed around Barnard's Star in 2024–2025 with the ESPRESSO spectrograph. Each planet is a fraction of Earth's mass and orbits in just days, far too hot for life — but their discovery finally delivered real planets at a star that had frustrated hunters for a hundred years.
